audio.assumptionLabel: Every numeric parameter below is hypothetical. Fixed monthly accepted output; unchanged editorial coordination in both workflows; one-time setup is incremental.
audio.minuteUnitNote: Generated duration is measured audio, never inferred from characters or credits. The hypothetical effective invoice rate includes all billed subscription allocation and overage for the workload; it is not ElevenLabs list pricing. Free regenerations and model-specific alternatives must be reconciled in a real invoice audit.

agents.assumptionLabel: Every numeric parameter below is hypothetical. One agent attempt per eligible unique task; every unsuccessful task requires the same full human effort as the manual baseline.
agents.completionDefinition: Task verified in the underlying business system, with no human fallback and no repeat contact for the same issue during the hypothetical seven-day window. The rate is an assumption, not ElevenLabs transcript-evaluator accuracy or a measured customer outcome.
agents.costBoundary: The hypothetical all-in invoice includes agent platform usage, LLM usage, carrier charges and any allocated subscription minimum. Oversight is charged separately as labor. It excludes customer waiting cost, harmful actions, and losses from undetected errors; accepting such tasks as completed would invalidate the rate.
